senses.gloss:
(म) r. 1st cl. (कणति)
1 To sound.
2 To cry as in distress.
(ऋ) कण r. 1st cl. (कणति)
To go or approach.
r. 10th cl. [] (कणयति)
To wink, to cover or close the eye with the lids or lashes.

mf. (-णः-णी or -णिका)
1 Small, minute.
2 An atom, a minute particle.
m. (-णः)
1 An eye of corn.
2 The spark or facet of a gem.
3 A spark of fire.
4 A drop of water, &c.
f. (-णा)
1 Cummin seed.
2 Long pepper.
3 A kind of fly, (कुम्भीरमक्षिका) the crocodile fly?
E.
कण to contract, अच् affix fem. टाप् or ङीष्.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
One-eyed, monoculous.
m. (-णः)
A crow.
E.
कण to sound, &c. अण् aff.

n. (-रः)
A white kind of cummin seed.
E.
कण small, and जीर cummin.

n. (-कं)
Small cummin seed.
E.
कण minute, and जीरक cummin.

m. (-कः)
A kind of bird.
E.
कण pepper, and भक्षक who eats.

m. (-भः)
A whirlpool.

m. (-नः)
A wagtail.
E.
कण little, अट to go, and ईनच् aff.

m. (-रः)
A wagtail; also कणाटीरक.

n. (-दः)
1 The name of a Muni, also called Kaśyapa: the author of the Vaiśeṣika philosophy.
2 A goldsmith.
E.
कण a little, and अद to eat, referring to the abstemiousness of the saint; or आदा to take, alluding to the proverbial dishonesty of the artificer.

m. (-कः)
1 A small particle, as a crystal, an eye of corn, &c.
2 An enemy.
3 Whirling round a set of lamps at sacrificial ceremonies.
4 The heart of wheat, commonly Suji, sharps or semoule.
f. (-का)
1 An atom, a small particle.
2 Small, minute: see कण.
3 A plant, (Premna spinosa): see गणिकारिका.
4 A kind of rice.
E.
कण small, वुन् affix, and इट् inserted, fem. affix टाप्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Small, diminutive.
E.
कण to be small, ईकन् Uṇādi affix; it is also written कनीक, and कणिक.

n. (-तं)
A cry or sound uttered through pain.
E.
कण to sound, affix क्त.

n. (-शं)
An ear or spike of corn.
E.
कण small, &c. affix श.

f. (-चिः)
1 A creeper in flower.
2 A cart.
3 The Abrus precatorius.
E.
कण to wink, ईचि Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Very small.
2 Young, younger.
E.
कण small, and ईयसुन् superlative affix; also कनीयस्.

m. (-रः)
A tree, (Cascaria ovata, &c.)
f. (-रा)
1 A courtezan.
2 A she-elephant.
E.
कण to go, एर affix, or with एरु affix अणेरु.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
One-eyed.
E.
काण, and द्रक aff.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A thorn.
2 A paltry foe.
3 A fish bone.
4 Horripilation, or the erection of the hair of the body.
5 Any annoyance or source of vexation.
6 A term in the Nyāya philosophy, implying refutation of argument, detection of error, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A workshop, a manufactory.
2 Fault, defect.
3 The point of a pin or needle.
4 A fish or marine monster, the symbol of KĀMADEVA: see मकर.
5 A bamboo.
E.
कटि to divide, वुन् aff.

m. (-मः)
The Śālmali or silk cotton tree.
E.
कण्टक, and द्रम a tree.

m. (-लः)
1 The Jaka or bread-fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
2 Another plant: see गोक्षुर.
3 The castor oil tree.
4 The Datura.
E.
कण्टक a spike, and फल fruit; the term is applicable to any plant, the fruit of which is invested with a hairy or thorny coat; also कण्टकिफल.

m. (-भुक्)
A camel.
E.
कण्टक, and भुज who eats.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
1 What treads down or extracts thorns.
2 What bridles or suppresses disturbances, annoyances, &c.
n. (-नं)
1 Beating down thorns.
2 Suppressing disturbances, &c.
E.
कण्टक, and मर्द्दन trampling on.

f. (-णी)
A porcupine.
E.
कण्टक, and श्रेणी a row.

m. (-रः)
A porcupine.
E.
कण्टक, and आगार a house.

f. (-का)
A sort of prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.)
E.
कण्टक a thorn, ऋ to go, अण् affix, कन् added with the feminine termination; also कण्टकारी.

f. (-री)
1 A prickly nightshade: see the preceding.
2 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.)
3 Another plant, commonly Buïñchi, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.)
E.
as before.

m. (-लः)
1 The bread-fruit tree or Jaka: see कण्टकफल.
2 A species of the coral tree, (Erythrina Indica.)
E.
कण्टक a thorn, आला to take, affix ड.

m. (-नः)
A camel.
E.
कण्टक, and अशन food; whose food is of thorns, thistles, &c.; also कण्टकभुज्, &c.

m. (-लः)
A kind of fish, one which has many bones.
E.
कण्टक, अस्थि a bone, and ईलच् aff.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
1 Produced from a fish.
2 Borne by the mimosa tree.
E.
कण्टकिन. and ज born.

mfn. (-की-किनी-कि)
1 Thorny, prickly.
2 Vexatious, annoying.
m. (-की)
1 A fish.
2 A tree, (Mimosa catechu.)
3 A plant, (Vangueria spinosa.)
4 A bamboo.
5 The jujube.
E.
कण्टक a thorn or small bone, and इनि poss. aff.

m. (-लः)
The Indian bread fruit tree or Jaka, (Artocarpus integrifolia): see कण्टकफल; also कण्टकीफल.

m. (-लः)
See कण्टकिफल, &c.

m. (-लः)
A thorny kind of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa, Rox.)

n. (-णं)
1 Weeding, extracting thorns, &c.
2 Removing annoyances.
3 Extirpating thieves, rogues, &c. or all national or public nuisances.
E.
कण्टक, and उद्धरण extracting.

m. (-त्रः)
A plant, commonly Buïñchi, (Flacourtia sapida, Rox.) and कण्टपत्रक.

m. (-लः)
1 The jack tree.
2 The Datura plant.
3 The castor oil plant.
E.
कण्ट for कण्टक a thorn or spike, फल fruit: see कण्टकफल.

m. (-लः)
The Jaca or Jack tree: see कण्टकफल.

m. (-लः)
The Babul, a tree yielding a species of gum arabic, (Acacia Arabica.) the branches are prickly, whence the name.
E.
कण्ट for कण्टक a thorn, and ल from ला to take or have.

m. (-री)
The jack tree.

mfn. (-ण्ठः-ण्ठा) or -ण्ठी-ण्ठं
1 The throat.
2 Sound, especially guttural sound.
3 Near, proximate.
m. (-ण्ठः)
1 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.)
2 The space of an inch from the edge of the hole in which sacrificial fire is deposited.
f. (-ण्ठी)
1 A rope or leather round the neck of a horse.
2 A necklace, a collar.
E.
कण to sound, ठ Uṇādi affix, fem. Affix. टाप् or ङीष्.

f. (-का)
The Vīṇā or Indian lute.
E.
कण्ठ the throat, कूण to sound, and ठक् affix; sounding like the larynx.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Extending to the throat or swallow.
E.
कण्ठ, and ग what goes.

f. (-का)
The leather or rope passing round the neck of a horse.

m. (-कः)
A kite.

m. (-कः)
A torch, a whisp of lighted straw, &c.

m. (-कः)
1 A halter.
2 A rope passing round an elephant's neck.
E.
कण्ठ, and पाशक a fetter.

f. (-षा)
A collar or short necklace.
E.
कण्ठ the throat, and भूषा an ornament.

m. (-णिः)
A jewel worn on the throat.
E.
कण्ठ, and मणि a gem.

mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं)
1 Fastened or suspended round the throat.
2 Clinging to, embracing.
E.
कण्ठ, and लग्न attached to.

f. (-ता)
1 A collar.
2 A horse's halter.
E.
कण्ठ, and लता a creeper.

n. (-नं)
Hanging on or round the throat.
E.
कण्ठ, and सज्जन equipping.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Sticking in the throat.
2 Being in or upon the throat.
3 Guttural.
4 Having by rote, ready to repeat.
E.
कण्ठ, and स्थ what stays.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Come in to the throat, (breath, &c.)
E.
कण्ठ, and आगत come.

m. (-ग्निः)
A bird.
E.
कण्ठ, and अग्नि fire, and figuratively digestive faculty; digesting in the throat or gizzard.

m. (-लः)
1 A boat.
2 A hoe, a spade.
3 War.
4 An esculent root, (Arum.)
5 A camel.
f. (-ला)
A churning vessel.
E.
कण्ठ the throat, अल to ornament, &c. अच् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Embracing, clinging to the neck.
E.
कण्ठ, and अवसक्त fastened to.

f. (-का)
A necklace of one string or row.
E.
कण्ठी and कन् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 A lion.
2 An elephant in rut.
3 A pigeon.
E.
कण्ठ the throat, and रव sound.

m. (-लः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
कण्ठे in the throat, काल black, black-necked; see नीलकण्ठ.

mfn. (-ण्ठ्यः-ण्ठ्या-ण्ठ्यं)
Guttural, belonging to the throat, pronounced from the throat, &c.
E.
कण्ठ and यत् aff.

n. (-नं)
Threshing, separating the chaff from grain.
f. (-नी)
A wooden bowl or mortar, in which the cleaning or threshing of grain is performed.
E.
कडि to divide, ल्युट् affix, fem. do. ङीष्.

f. (-रा)
A principal vessel of the body, a large artery, vein, &c.
E.
कडि to divide, अरन् aff.

f. (-ण्डुः)
1 The itch, itching.
2 Scratching: see कण्डू.

n. (ञ्) कण्डूञ् Sautra root, (कण्डूयति-ते^1)
1 To itch.
2 To scratch.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161202. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 303. note: 3rd sing. atmaneapada.

f. (-ण्डूः)
1 The itch, itching.
2 Scratching.
E.
कण्डूञ् to itch, affix क्विप्; also with the final short, कण्डु.

f. (-रा)
Cowach: see कण्डूरा.

f. (-रा)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
कण्डू itching, and रा what makes, from रा to take or give, affixes क and टाप; alluding to the irritating property of the leaves of this plant.

f. (-री)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
कण्डू itching, and कर what makes, ङीप् aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
Cassia, (fistula.)
E.
कण्डू, and घ्न what destroys.

f. (-तिः)
1 Itching, the itch.
2 Scratching.
E.
कण्डू and क्तिन् affix; also कण्डू, कण्डूयन, &c.

mfn. (-यन्-यती-यत्)
Scratching, rubbing.
E.
कण्डू to itch, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Itching.
2 Scratching; also कण्डूया and कण्डू.
E.
as before, affixes यक् and ल्युट्.

m. (-कः)
A tickler, one who tickles or scratches.
E.
कण्डूयन^1 and क who makes.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301.

f. (-या)
1 Itching.
2 Scratching.
E.
कण्डू to itch, affixes यक् and टाप्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Itchy, having the itch.
m. (-लः)
A esculent root, (Arum.)
E.
कण्डू and ला to have, ड aff.

m. (-लः)
1 A basket, a safe, any place in which provisions are kept.
2 A camel.
E.
कडि to divide, ओलच् Uṇādi affix; also with कन् added कण्डोलक.

m. (-कः)
A safe, a store room: see the preceding.

f. (-णा)
A vulgar lute.
E.
कण्डोल here implying a Cāṇḍāla, and वीणा the Vīṇā or Indian lute; also कटोलवीणा and कण्डोली.

f. (-ली)
See the preceding.

m. (-घः)
A caterpillar.
E.
कण्डु itching, and ओघ an abode.

m. (-ण्वः)
The name of a celebrated Muni or saint.
n. (-ण्वं)
Sin.
E.
कण to sound, क्वन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A crow.
E.
कण to sound, &c. and ऊकन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
One-eyed.
E.
काण, and ढक् aff.

mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
1 A stalk or stem.
2 The part of the trunk of a tree whence the branches proceed.
3 A cluster, a clump.
4 An arrow.
5 Opportunity, season.
6 Water.
7 A kind of reed, (Saccharum sara.)
8 A multitude, a heap, a quantity.
9 A horse.
10 A chapter, a section.
11 The part in a sacrifice appropriated to different objects, as the gods or manes.
12 A long bone, a bone of the extremities.
13 Praise, flattery.
14 Private, privacy.
15 Low, vile, bad.
16 Sinful, wicked.
E.
कन to shine, &c. डः Uṇādi affix, and the radical vowel made long.

m. (-कः)
A species of grass.
E.
काण्ड repeated.

n. (-रं)
The betle nut, the fruit of the areca.

m. (-रः)
An iron arrow.
E.
काण्ड a stem or stalk, and गोचर an object of sense: it is fired from a stock like the arrow of the cross bow.

f. (-णी)
A plant, commonly Rāmadūtī: see सूक्ष्मपर्णी.

m. (-कः)
A kind of gentian, (Gentiana cherayta, Rox.)
E.
काण्ड the stem, and तिक्त sharp, bitter, कन् added to this and similar compounds.

m. (-लः)
A plant with an astringent bark, commonly Lodh.
E.
काण्ड, and नील blue.

m. (-टः)
An outer tent, a screen surrounding a tent.
E.
काण्ड a stem, &c. and पट a cloth; also with कन् added काण्डपटकः.

n. (-ष्पः)
A small fragrant flower, commonly Dona, (Artemisia.)
E.
काण्ड the stem, and पुष्प flower; flowering from the stalk.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Of the military profession, a soldier.
m. (-ष्ठः)
1 The husband of a Vaiśya female.
2 An adopted or any other than the natural son.
n. (-ष्ठं)
The bow of KĀMA.
E.
काण्ड an arrow, and पृष्ठ the back: see काण्डस्पृष्ठ.

n. (-ग्नं)
A fracture of either of the extremities.
E.
काण्ड, and भग्न breaking.

f. (-हा)
A medicinal plant: see कटुकी.
E.
काण्ड the stem of a tree, and रुहा what ascends; hence it appears to be a creeper.

m. (-र्षिः)
A Ṛṣi or divine saint of a peculiar class; Jaimini and others who teach a particular Kāṇḍa or section of Vedas.
E.
काण्ड a section, and ऋषि a saint.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Armed with an arrow, an archer.
E.
काण्ड an arrow, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-न्धिः)
A knot, a joint in the stem of a tree, &c.
E.
काण्ड a stem, and सन्धि union.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Of the military profession, living by arms, a soldier.
E.
काण्ड an arrow, &c. स्पृश to touch, and क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
A fragrant grass, a sort of cyperus: see भद्रमुस्तक.
E.
काण्ड a stem, and हीन deprived.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Armed with an arrow, an archer.
m. (-रः)
1 A creeping plant, commonly Kāṇḍa Bel, (Momordica charantia.) []
2 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.)
f. (-रा)
Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith): see मञ्जिष्ठा.
E.
काण्ड an arrow, a stem, &c. and ईरच् aff.

n. (-क्षुः)
1 A plant, (Barleria longifolia.)
2 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum): see काश.
E.
काण्ड, and ईक्षु sugar cane; having a similar stem.
